name: ai_content_studio_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the ai_content_studio capability.

prompts.name: script_generation_prompt
prompts.template: Write a detailed script about the topic: {topic} with style {style} and length {length}.
prompts.use_case: YouTube content creators automating video production

prompts.name: voiceover_generation_prompt
prompts.template: Generate a natural voiceover for the script: {script} using voice type {voice_type} in language {language}.
prompts.use_case: Marketing teams generating video ads or promos rapidly

prompts.name: video_creation_prompt
prompts.template: Create a video by combining the voiceover audio: {voiceover_audio} with visual assets according to theme {theme}.
prompts.use_case: Educational content automation for video lessons

prompts.name: upload_video_prompt
prompts.template: Upload the video file {video_file} to YouTube with title '{title}', description '{description}', and tags {tags}.
prompts.use_case: Small businesses producing frequent video updates without manual editing
